tools.name: shape_post
tools.description: Turn rough notes about what the user did (shipped a feature, fixed a bug, hit a number) into 2-3 finished social-post angles in the user's voice. Grounded only in the notes - never invents facts. Uses one AI generation from the user's monthly quota.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: The user's connected social accounts (id, network, handle), their account groups (a named set, e.g. one business's Instagram + YouTube), and what each network needs: caption limit, whether it needs a photo or video, and the settings it takes. Call this first, then pass a group name or account handle

tools.name: get_upload_url
tools.description: Use this to post a file from the user's computer (a video you rendered, a photo). Returns uploadUrl and mediaUrl: PUT the raw file bytes to uploadUrl with its Content-Type header (the curl line in the result does it), then pass mediaUrl in the media list of create_draft or publish_post. Files are st

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Save a post as a DRAFT in the user's posthell queue, with any photos or videos and per-network settings (Instagram Reel cover, YouTube title/tags). Nothing is published by this tool: the user approves it in the dashboard. Optionally propose a publish time. Warnings in the result are what would stop

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Read the user's recent posts and drafts with per-network status, the live link once a post is up, and the reason when one failed. Published posts include engagement metrics (likes, comments, shares, engagementRate - impressions on plans with full analytics) once analytics have synced. Use it to avoi

tools.name: reschedule_post
tools.description: Change when a post goes out. Works on a post in the calendar (scheduled) and on a draft (its suggested time). Get the id from list_posts. A scheduled post is taken out of the network's queue and queued again at the new time; every network it was going to moves together.

tools.name: edit_post
tools.description: Change the caption (body), a network's own caption (overrides), and/or the suggested time of a DRAFT. Scheduled posts can only be moved with reschedule_post: changing the text of a post that is already scheduled needs a key the user has allowed to publish. Get the id from list_posts.

tools.name: get_growth
tools.description: The user's follower counts and 7-day growth per connected network, plus which network is growing fastest. Use this to decide where a post matters most or to report progress.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_upload_url, list_posts, reschedule_post, edit_post, get_growth · Private data: get_upload_url · Public sink: shape_post, get_upload_url, create_draft, list_posts, reschedule_post, edit_post, get_growth.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_upload_url, list_posts, reschedule_post, edit_post, get_growth · Private data: get_upload_url · Public sink: shape_post, get_upload_url, create_draft, list_posts, reschedule_post, edit_post, get_growth

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_draft" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Save a post as a DRAFT in the user's posthell queue. It is never published by this tool - the user approves it in the dashboard. Optionally propose a publish time (pre-fills their scheduler) and limit which platforms it targets (default: every connected account)." → after: "Save a post as a DRAFT in the user's posthell queue, with any photos or videos and per-network settings (Instagram Reel cover, YouTube title/tags). Nothing is published by this tool: the user approves it in the dashboard. Optionally propose a publish time. Warnings in the result are what would stop "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
